resources.string: Finite FreeRDP diagnostic probe. Connection, pixels and input require a real configured server; this is not Cloudy Desktop.
Import the operator-prepared rdp-config.json into this app’s private files directory before connecting. Server identity and credentials are never displayed here. There is no automatic reconnect.

Click the remote frame to focus physical keyboard and pointer input. Tab leaves the frame; focus loss releases held input. The native text composer below sends text only when Send is pressed; this is a separate diagnostic Unicode path, not direct remote IME integration.
Text to send to the remote session
Real remote framebuffer. Click to focus physical keyboard input; Tab leaves the frame.
